cards.card_text: Same with touching human uncleanness without knowing it.
cards.verse_text: Or if he touches human uncleanness—anything by which one becomes unclean—even if he is unaware of it, when he realizes it, he is guilty.
cards.snippet: Or if he touches human uncleanness—anything by which one becomes unclean—even if he is unaware of it, when…

cards.card_text: Then the priest sacrifices the sin offering to make atonement for him from his uncleanness, and after that he slaughters the burnt offering.
cards.verse_text: Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness.
cards.snippet: …offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness.

cards.card_text: Flowing or blocked, his discharge brings about uncleanness.
cards.verse_text: This uncleanness is from his discharge, whether his body allows the discharge to flow or blocks it.
cards.snippet: This uncleanness is from his discharge, whether his body allows the discharge to flow…

cards.card_text: Why must the children of Israel be kept separate from their uncleanness?
cards.verse_text: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is among them.
cards.snippet: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is…

cards.card_text: To cleanse it from Israel's uncleanness To mark it for the next high priest To warn the people to stay back
cards.verse_text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.
cards.snippet: …his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

cards.card_text: She had just purified herself from her uncleanness, and then she returns home.
cards.verse_text: (Now she had just purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned home.
cards.snippet: (Now she had just purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned home.

cards.card_text: All who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD eat with them.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites who had returned from exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel.
cards.snippet: …exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD, the God…

cards.verse_text: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end.
cards.snippet: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end.

cards.card_text: In the parable, God stops describing the rusted pot and speaks to "you." He says: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to ___ you, but you would not be purified from your filthiness.
cards.verse_text: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be purified from your filthiness.
cards.snippet: Because of the indecency of your uncleanness I tried to cleanse you, but you would not be purified from…

cards.card_text: God says He'll save them from all their uncleanness and won't bring famine on them.
cards.verse_text: I will save you from all your uncleanness.
cards.snippet: I will save you from all your uncleanness.

cards.card_text: He dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and there's that line again: He hid His face from them.
cards.verse_text: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and I hid My face from them.
cards.snippet: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions, and I hid My face from them.
